what: Leading-command scanner misses command substitutions and quoted paths
scenario_or_breakage: Existing in-scope calls include _plan_review_dispatch=$("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh" at skills/design/SKILL.md:573 and _plan_voter_dispatch=$("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dispatch-plan-voters.sh" at skills/design/references/plan-review.md:106, so a line-start command matcher can silently pass unmarked foreground-required invocations.
suggested_fix: Match basename invocations after optional assignments, command substitutions, and quotes, or use a small shell-line state machine; add fixtures for quoted paths, command-substitution assignment, and multiline continuation.

what: Foreground lint is not wired into CI-executed paths
scenario_or_breakage: CI runs make lint-only and matrix test-harnesses, while Makefile:12-18 documents lint as local convenience; adding lint-foreground only to lint means PR CI can stay green while marker drift ships.
suggested_fix: Add the foreground lint as a pre-commit local hook, a dedicated CI step, or a CI-executed Makefile prerequisite, and update the plan/docs to name that path.

what: New test target is not assigned to a Makefile shard
scenario_or_breakage: The shard guard inventories every test-* target and compares it against shard prereqs at scripts/test-harness-shards-coverage.sh:196-219; adding test-lint-foreground-markers without placing it on exactly one test-harnesses-N line like Makefile:50-80 makes make test-harnesses fail before the new harness provides coverage.
suggested_fix: Add test-lint-foreground-markers to .PHONY and exactly one test-harnesses-N shard, unless it is intentionally added to CARVE_OUTS, which would weaken this regression guard.
